{{Short description|Conditional access system for digital television}}
{{More citations needed|date=March 2008}}{{Expand section|date=February 2020}}

'''PowerVu''' is a [[conditional access system]] for [[digital television]] developed by [[Scientific Atlanta]].<ref>{{Cite web
  | title = PowerVu Network Centre Introduction   | work = Cisco Systems   | url = http://www.cisco.com/en/US/products/ps9359/index.html
  | accessdate = 2010-03-03}}</ref> It is used for professional broadcasting, notably by [[Retevision]], [[Bloomberg Television]], [[Discovery Channel]], [[AFRTS]], [[ABS-CBN]], [[GMA Network]], and [[American Forces Network]]. It is also used by cable companies to prevent viewing by unauthorized viewers and non-cable subscribers.

PowerVu has decoders that decode signals from certain satellites for cable distribution services. These decoders can also be used just like the [[FTA receiver|FTA]] (Free-To-Air) satellite receivers if properly configured.
